name: ROCKHAMPTON | PARKING - disability [GOOD]
description:
ROCKHAMPTON

This disability car park is very wide, which makes up for the garden on the left and the other car park on the right. The car park is quite and there is space to offload from the rear if you need to without obstructing traffic. The ramp into Spotlight is gentle and there are railings either side. Suitable for vision-impaired.
